title: Outpost Readiness
subtitle: Inspect the outpost before beginning scientific operations.
description: Investigate the current status of the Habitat and Engineering systems. Review their procedures and inspection logs, identify evidence-supported anomalies or data gaps, and submit an overall readiness assessment.

classifications.label: Anomaly detected
classifications.description: Available evidence indicates a possible or confirmed deviation.

classifications.label: No anomaly detected in the available evidence
classifications.description: The reviewed evidence does not show a deviation within the available checks and limits.

classifications.label: Insufficient evidence
classifications.description: The available records, measurements, or reference limits do not support a reliable conclusion.

validationRules: Every selected log entry must exist in the relevant system record.
A reported anomaly must reference supporting evidence.
A normal assessment must not be accepted as verified when required readings or reference limits are unavailable.
An insufficient-evidence conclusion must identify the missing or inadequate information.
The player's classification must be stored separately from the validated system finding.

tasks.title: Investigate Habitat Status
tasks.description: Inspect Habitat status information, life-support status, emergency status, procedures, and available inspection logs.
tasks.completionCondition: All required Habitat areas have been investigated and a valid inspection record has been submitted.

tasks.title: Investigate Water and Nutrition Systems
tasks.description: Review available water and nutrition status records, operating procedures, quality information, and relevant inspection logs.
tasks.completionCondition: A valid investigation record references the available water and nutrition evidence.

tasks.title: Inspect Engineering Monitoring Records
tasks.description: Review the available engineering monitoring status, procedure, and logs. Identify which records are relevant to overall outpost readiness.
tasks.completionCondition: The player submits a monitoring review that references valid records and explains their relevance.

tasks.title: Investigate the Power Unit
tasks.description: Examine available power status, operating procedure, readings, diagnostic messages, and inspection history. Determine whether the evidence supports an anomaly, no detected anomaly, or an inconclusive result.
tasks.completionCondition: The player submits a valid power investigation supported by available logs. The player is not required to report an anomaly if the evidence does not support one.

tasks.title: Inspect Engineering Life-Support Records
tasks.description: Inspect the Engineering Unit's life-support status, procedure, and available records. Compare related records only where the available data supports a meaningful comparison.
tasks.completionCondition: A valid Engineering life-support inspection is submitted with references to available records.

tasks.title: Review Engineering Diagnostics
tasks.description: Investigate available diagnostic logs, identify unresolved diagnostic messages, and decide whether additional checks are justified.
tasks.completionCondition: The player submits a supported diagnostic assessment, including an insufficient-evidence outcome when applicable.

tasks.title: Submit Outpost Readiness Assessment
tasks.description: Review the submitted Habitat and Engineering inspection records. Assess overall readiness, identify unresolved concerns, and submit a justified recommendation.

assessmentOptions.label: Ready
assessmentOptions.description: The submitted evidence supports proceeding with the planned operations.

assessmentOptions.label: Ready with cautions
assessmentOptions.description: Operations may proceed within the stated constraints while identified concerns are monitored.

assessmentOptions.label: Not ready
assessmentOptions.description: The evidence identifies a concern that should be resolved before proceeding.

assessmentOptions.label: Readiness undetermined
assessmentOptions.description: The available evidence is insufficient to justify a readiness decision.

validationRules: All required inspection tasks must have valid submitted records.
Every supporting record reference must exist.
The rationale must address relevant findings and unresolved concerns.
The assessment must not contradict the submitted evidence without an explanation.
An undetermined outcome is valid when the available evidence is insufficient.

tasks.completionCondition: The final readiness assessment passes validation against all mandatory inspection records.

optionalTasks.title: Review Engineering Storage Information
optionalTasks.description: Inspect available storage inventory information if useful for the readiness assessment.
